name: vermont-av-bus-speeds
title: Hourly bus speeds on Vermont Av, Los Angeles (LA Metro lines 204 and 754)

sources.title: LA Metro realtime API (GTFS-realtime vehicle positions)
Cal-ITP / Caltrans Average Transit Speeds by Stop

resources.name: hourly-all-sections
resources.title: Hourly speeds, corridor and six sections, 2016 onward

fields.name: hour_start_utc
fields.description: Start of the hour, UTC (ISO 8601).

fields.name: hour_start_local
fields.description: Start of the hour in America/Los_Angeles with UTC offset, e.g. 2024-05-01T17:00:00-0700.

fields.name: route
fields.description: LA Metro line: 204 (Local) or 754 (Rapid).

fields.name: direction
fields.description: northbound or southbound.

fields.name: section_id
fields.description: corridor (Sunset Bl to Athens Station) or S1..S6; see sections.csv.

fields.name: speed_mph
fields.description: Average speed over the section in miles per hour, stops and signals included (length_mi / travel_time).

fields.name: travel_time_min
fields.description: Average minutes to traverse the section. For corridor rows, the sum of the six section averages.

fields.name: length_mi
fields.description: Section length in miles.

fields.name: n_trips
fields.description: Trips contributing in that hour (for corridor rows, the fewest on any section).

fields.name: source
fields.description: gtfs_schedule = derived from the published timetable; gtfs_realtime_observed = measured from vehicle GPS.

fields.name: feed_version
fields.description: For gtfs_schedule rows: publication date and commit of the LACMTA/gtfs_bus version used. Empty for observed rows.
